name: mimg_share_image
description: Mint a link to one image that ANYONE can open, for handing to the user or pasting into a message. Give `image_id`, optionally `expires_in` (seconds, default 86400 = 24h, max 604800 = 7 days). Returns {url, expires_in}. Use this rather than the `url` field of a generation: that one is owner-authenticated and only opens for the signed-in owner in a browser. Say when the link expires whenever you give it out. Free — spends no credits.

expires_in.description: Seconds the link stays valid (60 to 604800; default 86400).
